valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2028 (year to July 2028) non-GAAP EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), times a justified P/E. USD listing, no ADR conversion. Anchor: FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance $5.47-$5.53 (midpoint $5.50, raised Nov 12 2026), Q1 FY27 non-GAAP EPS $1.40 on revenue $18.5B, FY27 revenue guide $74.8-75.8B, non-GAAP tax about 18.5%, diluted shares 3,978M. FY2028 EPS is my own assumption (no company guidance).

bear.driver: AI hyperscaler orders slow after the $9B FY27 build, memory and component costs squeeze gross margin, campus refresh fades; growth stalls.

base.driver: FY27 EPS at the $5.50 midpoint, then about 12.7% growth from AI infrastructure revenue, Splunk and security attach, buybacks of about $2B per quarter and stable margins; multiple stays at about 17.5x, below the 5-year premium after the post-earnings sell-off.

bull.driver: Hyperscaler AI revenue keeps compounding beyond $9B, enterprise campus upgrade cycle, operating margin expands; multiple recovers toward 20x.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2028 EPS of $6.20 the $95.64 close implies 15.4x (17.4x FY2027 guidance midpoint); the sampled analyst targets (about $120-$150, roughly $131 average) imply 21x at $6.20 or about $7.50 EPS at 17.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.20 (6.5 pp of the close); $0.30 of FY2028 EPS moves it by $5.25
valuation.watch_metric: Hyperscaler AI infrastructure revenue progress toward the $9B FY27 target and non-GAAP gross margin
valuation.next_disclosure: Q2 FY2027 earnings, expected February 2027; guide Q2 revenue $18.0-18.2B, non-GAAP EPS $1.34-1.36

analyst_notes: Seven named analysts (Evercore, Truist, KeyBanc, Goldman, UBS, Citi, Bernstein) are sampled, six of them the day after the Nov 12 release; only Truist and Citi cut targets (to $127 from $140 and $120 from $139), while Evercore sits highest at $150. Their roughly $131 average implies about 21x my base EPS versus my 17.5x, or EPS near $7.50 at my multiple; the gap is mostly multiple, since the Q1 beat and guide raise support my EPS. Morgan Stanley (downgrade to Equal-weight, target $120 from $135, Nov 2026), HSBC and DZ Bank calls are not included because the analyst is unnamed or they came after the reference close. Target horizons are undocumented so none enter the weighted target.
